\newcommand{\ConTeXLorenzArtwork}{%
  \begin{tikzpicture}
    % Trajectory scale is independent of equation typography.
    \begin{scope}[x=0.12cm,y=0.12cm]
      \ConTeXLorenzPath
    \end{scope}
    \node[anchor=north east,inner sep=0pt,text=ConTeXInk,font=\small]
      at ([yshift=-10pt]current bounding box.south east)
      {$\begin{gathered}
        \begin{aligned}
          \dot{x}&=\sigma(y-x),\\
          \dot{y}&=x(\rho-z)-y,\\
          \dot{z}&=xy-\beta z
        \end{aligned}\\[3pt]
        \scriptstyle\sigma=10,\quad\rho=28,\quad\beta=\tfrac83
      \end{gathered}$};
  \end{tikzpicture}}
% Legacy artwork API now renders the Lorenz replacement.
\newcommand{\ConTeXSpiralArtwork}{\ConTeXLorenzArtwork}
\makeatletter
\newcommand{\ConTeXTopicMotif}{\csname ConTeX@motif@\ProjectMotif\endcsname}
\expandafter\newcommand\csname ConTeX@motif@none\endcsname{}
\newcommand{\ConTeX@motif@engineering}{\begin{tikzpicture}[x=1cm,y=1cm,baseline=0pt,draw=NoteGreen!60!black,line width=0.5pt]
  \draw (0,0)--(0.35,0)--(0.35,0.3)--(1.2,0.3);\draw (0.7,-0.2)--(0.7,0.1)--(1.4,0.1);\end{tikzpicture}}
\newcommand{\ConTeX@motif@programming}{\begin{tikzpicture}[x=1cm,y=1cm,baseline=0pt,draw=NoteGreen!60!black,line width=0.5pt]
  \foreach \x in {0,0.6,1.2}{\draw (\x,0) rectangle +(0.2,0.2);}\draw (0.2,0.1)--(0.6,0.1) (0.8,0.1)--(1.2,0.1);\end{tikzpicture}}
\newcommand{\ConTeX@motif@phonetics}{\begin{tikzpicture}[x=1cm,y=1cm,baseline=0pt,draw=NoteGreen!60!black,line width=0.5pt]
  \draw[domain=0:1.4,samples=51] plot (\x,{0.18*sin(720*\x)});\end{tikzpicture}}
\newcommand{\ConTeX@motif@arabic}{\begin{tikzpicture}[x=1cm,y=1cm,baseline=0pt,draw=NoteGreen!60!black,line width=0.5pt]
  \draw (0,0) rectangle (0.5,0.5);\draw (0.25,-0.1)--(0.6,0.25)--(0.25,0.6)--(-0.1,0.25)--cycle;\end{tikzpicture}}
\newcommand{\ConTeX@motif@mathematics}{\begin{tikzpicture}[x=1cm,y=1cm,baseline=0pt,draw=NoteGreen!60!black,line width=0.5pt]
  \draw (0,0)--(1.3,0) (0,0)--(0,0.5);\draw[domain=0:1.2,samples=31] plot (\x,{0.3*\x*\x});\end{tikzpicture}}
\newcommand{\ConTeX@motif@research}{\begin{tikzpicture}[x=1cm,y=1cm,baseline=0pt,draw=NoteGreen!60!black,line width=0.5pt]
  \draw (0,0)--(0.6,0.35)--(1.2,0)--(0.6,-0.2)--cycle (0.6,0.35)--(0.6,-0.2);\foreach \p in {(0,0),(0.6,0.35),(1.2,0),(0.6,-0.2)}{\draw \p circle (1pt);}\end{tikzpicture}}
\makeatother

\newcommand{\ConTeXBackgroundOff}{\nopagecolor}
\RequirePackage{tcolorbox}
\tcbuselibrary{skins}
\definecolor{NoteGreen}{HTML}{26965B}
\definecolor{NoteRed}{HTML}{B94A48}
\newtcolorbox{notebox}[2][NoteGreen]{%
  enhanced,
  frame hidden,
  colback=#1!5!ConTeXBg,
  borderline west={2pt}{0pt}{#1},
  boxsep=0pt,
  left=10pt,
  right=10pt,
  top=8pt,
  bottom=8pt,
  before upper={%
    {\color{#1!60!black}\bfseries #2}\enspace
  }
}

% Standard title fields are canonical; legacy accessors remain available.
\definecolor{ConTeXInk}{HTML}{262626}
\makeatletter
\def\ConTeX@unsettitle{\@latex@error{No \noexpand\title given}\@ehc}
\def\ConTeX@unsetauthor{\@latex@warning@no@line{No \noexpand\author given}}
\def\ConTeX@defaultdate{\today}
\ifx\@title\ConTeX@unsettitle\gdef\@title{}\fi
\ifx\@author\ConTeX@unsetauthor\gdef\@author{}\fi
\ifx\@date\ConTeX@defaultdate\gdef\@date{}\fi
\providecommand{\@subtitle}{}
\providecommand{\subtitle}[1]{\gdef\@subtitle{#1}}
\providecommand{\ProjectTitle}{\@title}
\providecommand{\ProjectSubtitle}{\@subtitle}
\providecommand{\ProjectAuthor}{\@author}
\providecommand{\ProjectDate}{\@date}
\providecommand{\ProjectShortTitle}{}
\providecommand{\ProjectType}{}
\providecommand{\ProjectAffiliation}{}
\providecommand{\ProjectCourse}{}
\providecommand{\ProjectGeneralInfo}{}
\providecommand{\ProjectMotif}{none}
\ExplSyntaxOn
\keys_define:nn { contex/project }
  {
    title       .code:n = \title{#1},
    subtitle    .code:n = \subtitle{#1},
    author      .code:n = \author{#1},
    date        .code:n = \date{#1},
    short-title .code:n = \cs_gset:Npn \ProjectShortTitle {#1},
    type        .code:n = \cs_gset:Npn \ProjectType {#1},
    affiliation .code:n = \cs_gset:Npn \ProjectAffiliation {#1},
    course      .code:n = \cs_gset:Npn \ProjectCourse {#1},
    general-info .code:n = \cs_gset:Npn \ProjectGeneralInfo {#1},
    motif .choices:nn = {none,engineering,programming,phonetics,arabic,mathematics,research}
      { \cs_gset:Npx \ProjectMotif {\l_keys_choice_tl} },
  }
\NewDocumentCommand{\projectsetup}{m}
  { \keys_set:nn { contex/project } {#1} }
% Expand the field once without expanding formatting inside its value.
\NewDocumentCommand{\ConTeX@IfBlankTF}{m +m +m}
  { \tl_if_blank:oTF {#1} {#2} {#3} }
\ExplSyntaxOff
\@onlypreamble\projectsetup
\newcommand{\ConTeX@GeneralInfo}{%
  \ConTeX@IfBlankTF{\ProjectGeneralInfo}{\@date}{\ProjectGeneralInfo}}
\newcommand{\ConTeX@HeaderTitle}{%
  \ConTeX@IfBlankTF{\ProjectShortTitle}{%
    \ConTeX@IfBlankTF{\@subtitle}{\@title}{\@subtitle}}{\ProjectShortTitle}}
\RequirePackage{fancyhdr}
\newcommand{\ConTeX@FooterAuthor}{\begingroup\let\thanks\@gobble\def\and{,\space}\@author\endgroup}
\newcommand{\ConTeX@RunningStyle}{%
  \fancyhf{}
  \fancyhead[L]{\normalfont\rmfamily\small\color{ConTeXInk}%
    \parbox[b]{\headwidth}{\raggedright\let\thanks\@gobble\ConTeX@HeaderTitle}}
  \fancyfoot[L]{\normalfont\rmfamily\small\color{ConTeXInk}%
    \parbox[t]{0.42\headwidth}{\raggedright\ConTeX@FooterAuthor}}
  \fancyfoot[C]{\normalfont\rmfamily\small\color{ConTeXInk}\thepage}
  \fancyfoot[R]{\normalfont\rmfamily\small\color{ConTeXInk}%
    \parbox[t]{0.42\headwidth}{\raggedleft\@date}}
  \renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0.4pt}
  \renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0.3pt}}
\let\ConTeX@headrule\headrule
\let\ConTeX@footrule\footrule
\renewcommand{\headrule}{{\color{ConTeXInk!25!ConTeXBg}\ConTeX@headrule}}
\renewcommand{\footrule}{{\color{ConTeXInk!25!ConTeXBg}\ConTeX@footrule}}
\pagestyle{fancy}\ConTeX@RunningStyle
\fancypagestyle{plain}{\ConTeX@RunningStyle}
% Size running matter after the final preamble setters, before any page ships.
\newsavebox{\ConTeX@measure}
\newlength{\ConTeX@runningheight}
\AtBeginDocument{%
  \ConTeX@IfBlankTF{\@title}{\gdef\@title{Untitled notes}}{}%
  \sbox{\ConTeX@measure}{\parbox{\textwidth}{\normalfont\small\raggedright\let\thanks\@gobble\ConTeX@HeaderTitle}}%
  \setlength{\ConTeX@runningheight}{\dimexpr\ht\ConTeX@measure+\dp\ConTeX@measure+2pt\relax}%
  \ifdim\headheight<\ConTeX@runningheight\setlength{\headheight}{\ConTeX@runningheight}\fi
  \sbox{\ConTeX@measure}{\parbox[t]{0.42\textwidth}{\normalfont\small\raggedright\ConTeX@FooterAuthor}}%
  \setlength{\ConTeX@runningheight}{\dimexpr\ht\ConTeX@measure+\dp\ConTeX@measure+12pt\relax}%
  \ifdim\footskip<\ConTeX@runningheight\setlength{\footskip}{\ConTeX@runningheight}\fi
  \sbox{\ConTeX@measure}{\parbox[t]{0.42\textwidth}{\normalfont\small\raggedleft\@date}}%
  \setlength{\ConTeX@runningheight}{\dimexpr\ht\ConTeX@measure+\dp\ConTeX@measure+12pt\relax}%
  \ifdim\footskip<\ConTeX@runningheight\setlength{\footskip}{\ConTeX@runningheight}\fi}
\setlength{\parindent}{1em}
\setlength{\parskip}{0.25em}
\setlength{\emergencystretch}{2em}
\newcommand{\divider}[1]{\par\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{#1}\par}
\newcommand{\ConTeX@TitleField}[2]{%
  \ConTeX@IfBlankTF{#2}{}{\vspace{0.5em}{#1#2\par}}}
\newif\ifConTeX@RestorePageAnchor
\RenewDocumentCommand{\maketitle}{o}{%
  \ConTeX@RestorePageAnchorfalse
  \@ifundefined{ifHy@pageanchor}{}{%
    \ifHy@pageanchor\ConTeX@RestorePageAnchortrue\fi
    \hypersetup{pageanchor=false}}%
  \begin{titlepage}
    \thispagestyle{empty}
    \normalfont\rmfamily\raggedright\color{ConTeXInk}
    \setlength{\parindent}{0pt}\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}
    \noindent\parbox[t][1cm][c]{\textwidth}{%
      {\color{NoteGreen!60!black}\rule{2.2cm}{0.8pt}}\hfill\ConTeXTopicMotif}\par
    \vspace{0.065\textheight}
    {\fontsize{30}{35}\selectfont\bfseries\@title\par}
    \ConTeX@IfBlankTF{\@subtitle}{}{%
      \vspace{0.75em}{\Large\color{ConTeXInk!80!ConTeXBg}\@subtitle\par}}
    \vspace{1.3em}
    \ConTeX@TitleField{\small\let\and\par}{\@author}
    \ConTeX@TitleField{\small}{\ProjectAffiliation}
    \ConTeX@TitleField{\small}{\ProjectCourse}
    \ConTeX@IfBlankTF{\ProjectGeneralInfo}{%
      \ConTeX@TitleField{\small}{\@date}}{%
      \ConTeX@TitleField{\small}{\ProjectGeneralInfo}}
    \vfill
    \noindent\hfill\ConTeXLorenzArtwork\par
    \vspace{0.02\textheight}
    {\color{NoteRed!70!black}\rule{0.7cm}{0.6pt}\par}
    \@thanks
  \end{titlepage}%
  \ifConTeX@RestorePageAnchor\hypersetup{pageanchor=true}\fi}
